subject: funder
label: maintains
description: A Funder maintains one or more Grant Programs, each of which issues Funding Opportunities over time.

subject: grant-program
label: issues
description: A Grant Program issues Funding Opportunities during defined Funding Cycles.

subject: funding-opportunity
label: occurs during
description: A Funding Opportunity is issued within a defined Funding Cycle.

subject: funding-opportunity
label: specifies
description: A Funding Opportunity specifies the Eligibility Criteria an applicant must meet.

subject: funding-opportunity
label: may require
description: A Funding Opportunity may require a Letter of Inquiry before a full Application is invited.

subject: grantee
label: submits
description: A Grantee (or a project operating under a Fiscal Sponsor) submits an Application in response to a Funding Opportunity.

subject: application
label: responds to
description: An Application is submitted in response to a specific Funding Opportunity.

subject: application
label: includes
description: An Application includes a proposed Budget.

subject: fiscal-sponsor
label: acts on behalf of
description: A Fiscal Sponsor stands in for a Grantee that lacks independent legal status to receive an Award directly.

subject: application
label: undergoes
description: An Application undergoes Review by one or more Reviewers.

subject: review
label: is conducted by
description: A Review is conducted by one or more Reviewers.

subject: review
label: is evaluated against
description: A Review evaluates an Application against published Review Criteria.

subject: review
label: may include
description: A Review may include a Site Visit before a Decision is made.

subject: review
label: produces
description: A Review produces a Decision.

subject: decision
label: results in
description: An approved Decision results in an Award.

subject: award
label: is formalized by
description: An Award is formalized by a Grant Agreement.

subject: grant-agreement
label: specifies
description: A Grant Agreement specifies Terms and Conditions, including whether funding is restricted or unrestricted.

subject: grant-agreement
label: may include
description: A Grant Agreement may include a Matching Requirement.

subject: award
label: has
description: An Award's funds are released according to a Payment Schedule.

subject: payment-schedule
label: is broken into
description: A Payment Schedule is broken into Installments.

subject: installment
label: may have
description: An Installment may carry a Payment Condition that must be met before it is disbursed.

subject: installment
label: is disbursed as
description: An Installment is disbursed as a Payment once any Payment Condition is satisfied.

subject: grantee
label: may request
description: Over the life of an Award, the Grantee may request a Budget Modification.

subject: amendment
label: modifies
description: An Amendment changes the Grant Agreement going forward; it does not retroactively alter Payments or Reports already completed under the prior terms.

subject: grant-agreement
label: attaches
description: A Grant Agreement attaches Compliance Requirements, including a Reporting Schedule.

subject: compliance-requirement
label: includes
description: A Compliance Requirement includes a Reporting Schedule that obligates the Grantee to submit Reports.

subject: compliance-requirement
label: may include
description: A Compliance Requirement may include an Audit.

subject: reporting-schedule
label: obligates
description: A Reporting Schedule obligates the Grantee to submit Reports on a defined cadence.

subject: report
label: is assessed against
description: Reports are assessed against the project's Logic Model in terms of Outputs and Outcomes.

subject: report
label: is assessed against
description: Reports are assessed against the project's Theory of Change in terms of Outputs and Outcomes.

subject: evaluation
label: assesses
description: An Evaluation assesses whether a grant-funded project achieved its intended Outputs.

subject: evaluation
label: assesses
description: An Evaluation assesses whether a grant-funded project achieved its intended Outcomes.

subject: award
label: reaches
description: Once all Payments are disbursed and all Compliance Requirements are satisfied, the Award reaches Closeout.

subject: award
label: follows
description: An Award's progression from decision through closeout follows the Grant Lifecycle sequence.

subject: program-officer
label: is associated with
description: A Program Officer is associated with one or more Grant Programs and typically owns the Review and monitoring relationship for Awards made under them.

subject: grant-administrator
label: is responsible for
description: A Grant Administrator is typically responsible for Report submission.

subject: grant-administrator
label: is responsible for
description: A Grant Administrator is typically responsible for tracking Compliance Requirements.
